about.title: Newark Slip & Fall Claims
about.longDescription: Falls happen fast, but the aftermath can drag on for weeks or months as you deal with pain, missed work, and medical appointments. In Newark, these incidents often occur at retail centers and multi-unit properties near corridors like Cedar Boulevard, Thornton Avenue, and Newark Boulevard, where foot traffic is heavy and wet floors, uneven pavement, or poor lighting can go unaddressed. California law asks whether the property owner knew, or reasonably should have known, about the hazard that caused your fall. That's why what happens right after the fall matters: photos of the scene, the name of an employee or witness, and a request that surveillance footage be preserved can all shape whether a claim succeeds. LawProactive doesn't handle claims itself. Instead, we connect you with an independent attorney in our network who can review what happened, explain your options under California's fault rules, and help you understand next steps, all without any upfront cost to you.

items.title: We Understand the Notice Requirement
items.desc: California premises liability claims hinge on whether the property owner knew or should have known about the hazard. The attorney you're matched with can help identify evidence, like maintenance logs or prior complaints, that speaks to that notice.

items.title: We Emphasize Preserving Evidence Early
items.desc: Surveillance footage at Newark stores and apartment complexes is often overwritten within days or weeks. An independent attorney can move quickly to request that footage be preserved before it's lost.

items.title: No Upfront Cost, No Risk to You
items.desc: Attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover compensation. That lets you focus on healing instead of worrying about legal bills.

items.question: How long do I have to file a slip and fall claim in Newark?
items.answer: In most cases, California gives you two years from the date of the fall to file a lawsuit. If the property involved is owned by a government entity, such as a city building or public sidewalk in Newark, that deadline is much shorter and requires an earlier claim filing. Because the timeline can vary, it helps to speak with an attorney as soon as possible.

items.question: What if I was partly at fault for my fall?
items.answer: California follows a pure comparative fault rule, which means you can still recover compensation even if you were partly responsible for the accident, though your recovery may be reduced by your share of fault. This is different from states that bar recovery entirely above a certain fault percentage. An attorney can help evaluate how fault might be allocated in your specific situation.

items.question: Where do most reported slip and fall incidents happen in Newark?
items.answer: Public collision and incident data shows heavy foot and vehicle traffic along corridors like Cedar Boulevard, Thornton Avenue, Cherry Street, and Newark Boulevard, often peaking on Thursday evenings between 5 and 7 p.m. Retail centers and multi-unit properties along these corridors see frequent visitor traffic, which can increase the chance of an unaddressed hazard. This pattern doesn't mean any location is inherently unsafe, but it does mean property maintenance matters in these high-traffic areas.
